execution_workflow.description: Clear vegetation, construction debris, old turf, and remove waste material from the site before planting.
Turn existing soil, loosen compaction, add organic amendments, manure, and improve drainage.
Install sub-surface drains, gravel trenches, and edge drains in low-lying or patio areas.
Lay pathways, seating pads, edging, and boundary kerbs before final planting and turf work.
Apply compost, cow manure, biochar, and soil conditioners to prepared beds and planting pockets.
Plant trees, shrubs, climbers, and bedding plants according to the layout with correct pit size and spacing.
Lay turf with a 10% wastage allowance for cutting and site loss, roll and finish the lawn edges.
Install drip lines, valves, filters and test the micro-irrigation system for planted zones.
Water the entire project, settle soil and turf, and inspect for required adjustments.

contract_models.itemized: Detailed bill of quantities with separate line items for materials, labor, irrigation, turfing, planting and hardscaping.
contract_models.lump_sum: Turnkey contract with a single price for full garden execution including site preparation, planting and commissioning.

deal_terms: Seasonal pricing factor is applied according to monsoon, winter and summer nursery availability.
Apply 10% wastage buffer on soil and turf quantities for site loss and cutting.
Include a 5-10% contingency buffer on the proposal total for unforeseen site conditions.
Offer AMC pricing at 8-12% of the total project cost per year for ongoing garden upkeep.
Itemized proposals must clearly distinguish between material, workmanship, and system commissioning costs.
procurement_logic: Local nursery hubs are matched to the site region and plant type to create a lowest-risk sourcing plan. Use premium Bangalore nurseries for tropical designer plants; use Saharanpur for decorative roses and established specimens.
